readOnlyNotice: You have read-only access. Ask an administrator to change these settings.

fields.name: Name
fields.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, digits, '-' and '_'. This is the site id used by ParkIT and the app, and it cannot be changed later.
fields.slugReadOnly: The site id is used by ParkIT and the app and cannot be changed.
fields.timeZoneHelp: IANA name, for example Africa/Johannesburg. Leave empty on creation to use the default.
fields.topicHelp: The FCM topic the app subscribes to for this site. Leave empty to use the default.
fields.listedHelp: Whether the site appears in the app's site list.
fields.managedHelp: Managed sites send push notifications from this backend. Shadow sites only record and evaluate, and send nothing.

list.title: Sites
list.description: Parking sites that report to Freespace.

create.title: Create site
create.description: A new site starts in shadow mode and is not listed in the app until you enable it.

overview.identityDescription: How the site is named and addressed.
overview.modeDescription: Control whether the backend sends notifications for this site and whether the app shows it.
overview.managedOff: Site is now in shadow mode

managedConfirmOn.title: Turn on managed mode?
managedConfirmOn.description: Turning on managed mode makes this backend send push notifications to every phone subscribed to {{name}}. Before you continue, make sure the legacy ParkIT notifier is turned off for this site, otherwise phones will receive duplicate messages.

managedConfirmOff.title: Turn off managed mode?
managedConfirmOff.description: {{name}} will go back to shadow mode. The backend keeps evaluating but stops sending push notifications. Turning managed mode on again starts a fresh cycle.

overview.dangerDescription: Removes the site from the back office and the app.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this site?
deleteConfirm.description: {{name}} will stop accepting data from ParkIT and disappear from the app. This cannot be undone from the back office.

trigger.title: When to notify
trigger.description: Occupancy thresholds and how much a change must be before phones are told.

data.title: Data quality and recovery
data.description: When ParkIT data is treated as stale, and whether to send an all-clear.

zoneAdvisory.title: Zone advisories
zoneAdvisory.description: Optional messages when a single zone fills up. The percentage that triggers one is set on each zone.

limits.title: Per-phone limits and expiry
limits.description: The cooldown and daily cap apply only when the deployment limits notifications per device and site. The expiry applies to every push.

window.title: Notification window
window.description: Phones are only notified inside these windows, in the site's local time ({{timeZone}}). Leave the list empty to notify at any time.
window.anyTime: No window set: notifications can be sent at any time.

trigger_pct.label: Trigger occupancy
trigger_pct.help: Notify when site occupancy reaches this percentage (1-100).

reset_pct.label: Reset occupancy
reset_pct.help: Occupancy must fall below this percentage, which must be lower than the trigger, before a new cycle can start.

change_points.label: Change threshold
change_points.help: Percentage points the situation must change by before a follow-up message is sent (1-50).

change_direction.label: Change direction
change_direction.help: Whether follow-up messages are sent only when occupancy rises or in both directions.

stabilisation_s.label: Stabilisation time
stabilisation_s.help: How long a change must hold before it is sent (0-3600 seconds).

recommendation_margin.label: Recommendation margin
recommendation_margin.help: Free bays a zone must have over the current recommendation to replace it (0 or more).

stale_limit_s.label: Stale limit
stale_limit_s.help: Data older than this is treated as stale. At least 120 seconds, twice ParkIT's posting interval.

partial_is_stale.label: Partial data counts as stale
partial_is_stale.help: Treat a submission with missing zones as stale.

recovery_push.label: Send recovery message
recovery_push.help: Tell phones when availability has improved after an advisory.

zone_advisory.label: Send zone advisories
zone_advisory.help: Notify when an individual zone with an advisory percentage fills up.

zone_reset_gap.label: Zone reset gap
zone_reset_gap.help: How far below its advisory percentage a zone must fall before it can advise again (1-50 points).

cooldown_s.label: Cooldown per phone
cooldown_s.help: Minimum time between two pushes to the same phone for this site (0 or more seconds).

daily_cap.label: Daily cap per phone
daily_cap.help: Maximum pushes per phone and site per day (0 or more).

push_expiry_s.label: Push expiry
push_expiry_s.help: How long a push stays deliverable if the phone is offline (60-86400 seconds).

zones.title: Zones
zones.description: Zones in the order the app shows them. Capacity comes from ParkIT and is not edited here.
zones.createDescription: Create a zone before ParkIT reports it, or to prepare its settings.
zones.editDescription: Change how this zone is shown and recommended.
zones.saveMarksReviewed: This zone was created automatically from a ParkIT report. Saving it marks it as reviewed.
zones.empty: No zones yet. Zones appear when ParkIT first reports them.
zones.thresholdsValue: Limited {{limited}}%, full {{full}}% or under {{minFree}} free, unknown {{unknown}}%

discoveredNotice.title: {{count}} zone(s) created automatically need review
discoveredNotice.description: ParkIT reported zones that were not set up here. They stay hidden from the app until you review and enable them.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this zone?
deleteConfirm.description: {{name}} will be removed from the site and the app.

fields.name: Name
fields.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, digits, '-' and '_'. Matches the id ParkIT uses. Cannot be changed later.
fields.slugReadOnly: The zone id cannot be changed.
fields.enabledHelp: Show this zone in the app.
fields.recommendableHelp: Allow this zone to be recommended. A zone can be shown but never recommended.
fields.preferredHelp: Prefer this zone when recommendations are otherwise close.
fields.limited_pctHelp: Occupancy percentage at which the zone is shown as limited.
fields.full_pctHelp: Occupancy percentage at which the zone is shown as full.
fields.full_min_free: Full at or below free bays
fields.full_min_freeHelp: The zone is also full when fewer than this many bays are free.
fields.unknown_limit_pctHelp: Largest share of bays with unknown state before the zone is shown as unknown.
fields.advisory_pctHelp: Send a zone advisory at this occupancy. Leave empty for no zone advisory.
fields.noteHelp: For staff only, for example how the zone is sensed. Never sent to the app.

templates.intro: The wording of each push message for this site. Insert placeholders from the list to fill in live values.
templates.insertHint: Click a placeholder to insert it where the cursor is.
templates.unknown: This message type does not provide: {{names}}. Remove them before saving.
templates.resetDone: Message reset to the default wording

resetConfirm.title: Reset to the default wording?
resetConfirm.description: Your changes to this message will be replaced with the default title and message.

placeholderHelp.topZones: The zones with the most bays, such as Basement 3 and Basement 4
placeholderHelp.occupancyPct: Site occupancy as a whole number

SITE_INITIAL.title: Parking filling up
SITE_INITIAL.description: First message when site occupancy reaches the trigger.

SITE_CHANGE.title: Recommendation changed
SITE_CHANGE.description: Follow-up when the recommended zone or the situation changes.

ZONE_ADVISORY.title: Zone full
ZONE_ADVISORY.description: Sent when a single zone fills up and another has room.

RECOVERY.title: Availability improved
RECOVERY.description: Sent when parking has eased after an advisory.

TEST.title: Test message
TEST.description: Used by the test push in the back office.

fields.name: Name
fields.expiresHelp: Optional. The key stops working at the end of the chosen day.

reveal.warning: It is shown only once. It cannot be retrieved later, only replaced with a new key.
reveal.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the key and copy it manually.

ingest.title: Ingest keys
ingest.description: Keys ParkIT uses to send occupancy data for this site.
ingest.rotationTitle: Rotating a key without a gap
ingest.rotation: Several keys can be valid at once. To rotate: create a new key, enter it in ParkIT, check that its last-used time updates, and only then revoke the old key.
ingest.createDescription: Give the key a name that tells you where it is used.
ingest.revealDescription: Enter this key in ParkIT for this site.

revokeConfirm.title: Revoke this key?
revokeConfirm.description: ParkIT will no longer be able to send data with the key "{{name}}". Make sure ParkIT already uses a newer key.

app.title: App keys
app.description: Keys the Freespace mobile app sends with its requests. They apply to the whole deployment.
app.rotation: At least two keys can be valid at once so that an app release can switch keys. Create the new key, ship the release that uses it, and revoke the old key once old versions are retired.
app.createDescription: Give the key a name that identifies the app release it is for.
app.revealDescription: Build this key into the app release.

revokeConfirm.title: Revoke this app key?
revokeConfirm.description: App versions that use the key "{{name}}" will be refused. Make sure users have moved to a release with a newer key.

validation.resetBelowTrigger: Reset occupancy must be lower than the trigger occupancy
validation.limitedBelowFull: Limited occupancy must not be higher than full occupancy
validation.slug: Use lowercase letters, digits, '-' and '_' (up to 64 characters, starting with a letter or digit)
validation.timeZone: Enter a valid time zone name, for example Africa/Johannesburg

window.startNotBeforeEnd: The start must be before the end. A window cannot run past midnight.

live.title: Live view
live.intro: The zone table is computed exactly as the app computes it. It refreshes every 15 seconds while this tab is visible.
live.loadError: Could not load the live view

zones.title: Zones
zones.description: Zones as the app sees them. Zones that are not enabled are not shown in the app.

engine.title: Notification engine
engine.description: A push is considered when occupancy reaches {{trigger}}% and the engine is reset again below {{reset}}%.
engine.noState: The engine has not evaluated this site yet.
engine.idle: Idle: no occupancy rise is being tracked.
engine.dueNow: The stabilisation time is over; the next evaluation decides.

inflight.title: Advisory in flight
inflight.description: A push is being sent to devices right now. An identical advisory is not started again until it finishes.

engine.neverNotified: No advisory sent in this cycle
engine.advisoryWatching: {{zone}}: above its level since {{since}}, not yet advised

events.intro: Everything the engine and the intake decided for this site. Counts show how many devices were affected; devices are never identified.
events.noAccess: You do not have access to the event log.

filters.periodInvalid: The first day must not be after the last day.

reasons.NOT_STABLE: Not stable (fell back before the stabilisation time)

push.topicWarning: This goes to the topic {{topic}} and reaches every subscribed phone of this site at once. It cannot be recalled.
push.confirmLabel: Type the topic name "{{topic}}" to confirm

test.title: Send a test push
test.description: Sends a test message that does not count against any limit. It works for shadow sites too.
test.targetTopic: Every subscriber of the site topic
test.suffixLabel: Last 6 characters of the device id
test.suffixHelp: Shown in the app's settings. Exactly 6 letters, digits, '-' or '_'.

announce.title: Send an announcement
announce.description: Sends a free-text message to every subscriber of this site's topic. No cooldown or daily cap applies.

result.note: "Accepted by FCM" means Google took the message for delivery. It does not confirm that any phone received it.

devices.title: Device statistics
devices.description: How many phones use the app, across your sites. Counts only; devices are never identified here.
devices.intro: Counts only; devices are never identified here.

history.title: Occupancy history
history.description: Occupancy over one day, in the site's time zone ({{timeZone}}). Dashed lines mark the trigger and reset levels.
history.empty: No occupancy data was recorded on this day.
history.gapNote: Where the line is broken, no data was received; it does not mean zero.

simulator.title: Simulator
simulator.description: Walk a site through the acceptance scenarios with made-up figures and a movable clock.

unavailable.title: Not available
unavailable.description: The simulator only exists when the backend runs in mock mode. It is not enabled here.

simulator.notice: Mock mode is on. Snapshots you post here are stored for the chosen site as if ParkIT had sent them. Use a demonstration site.

result.title: Observed state
result.description: What the backend shows for this site now.

clock.title: Mock clock
clock.description: Moves the backend's clock forward so timers expire. An engine evaluation runs after each move.

snapshot.title: Post a snapshot
snapshot.description: Free bays are computed as capacity minus occupied.

presets.title: Acceptance scenarios
presets.description: Pick a scenario and run it step by step. Each step states the expected outcome next to what the backend shows.

AT-01.title: Quiet site
AT-01.description: A site at a low level is served normally and produces no candidate.

AT-02.title: Not stable
AT-02.description: The trigger is crossed but occupancy falls back before the stabilisation time.

AT-03.title: Stabilised
AT-03.description: The trigger level is held for the stabilisation time, so the first advisory is sent.

AT-04.title: Rising further
AT-04.description: Already active and notified, occupancy rises a little more.

AT-05.title: Material change
AT-05.description: Already active, occupancy rises by the change step, first with the same recommendation, then with a new one.

AT-06.title: Reset and new cycle
AT-06.description: Occupancy falls below the reset level, then rises to the trigger again.

AT-07.title: One zone full
AT-07.description: The site is below the trigger while one zone is nearly full and another is free.

AT-08.title: Stale data
AT-08.description: No data for three minutes, then a zone reported offline.

expected.holding: Still pending while {{pct}}% is held for {{seconds}} s more.
expected.idleNoCandidate: At {{pct}}% the site stays idle and no candidate is logged.
expected.pending: At {{pct}}% the state becomes pending and the timer starts.
expected.notStable: Back at {{pct}}% the state returns to idle and a NOT_STABLE event is logged. No push is sent.
expected.active: The stabilisation time has passed: state active. On a managed site the first advisory is sent to eligible devices; on a shadow site it is logged as UNMANAGED.
expected.noCandidate: At {{pct}}% the state stays active and no new candidate is created.
expected.noMaterialChange: At {{pct}}% with the same recommendation the candidate is dropped as NO_MATERIAL_CHANGE.
expected.newRecommendation: With a new recommendation an advisory is sent to devices that are out of cooldown and under their daily cap; the others are logged as COOLDOWN or DAILY_CAP.
expected.reset: At {{pct}}% the state returns to idle (a recovery push only if enabled).
expected.newCycle: Rising to {{pct}}% starts a new cycle: pending again.
expected.recommendOther: At {{pct}}% the site stays idle and sends no push, while the app recommends the free zone.
expected.staleData: After {{seconds}} s without data the site is stale and candidates are logged as STALE_DATA.
expected.zoneUnknown: The offline zone shows as unknown and is never recommended.
